artifact_observations.reasoning: The rust texture on the fender arch appears slightly smudged and painterly rather than having sharp, granular detail typical of real corrosion.
The red logo in the center is indistinct and lacks geometric precision, appearing slightly melted or warped rather than a crisp emblem.
The flattening of the tire at the bottom is minimal and the transition to the ground is slightly soft, lacking the sharp compression line expected under vehicle weight.
